summary: My most seven frequent apps: Firefox Preview, Chrome (my blog) , Slack, Nuzzel, Indigenous (my social reader), Signal. #digped If you keep social media off your phone it can't get in your head. Keep work email off your phone and try to enjoy life.

body_html:
My most seven frequent apps: Firefox Preview, Chrome (my blog) , Slack, Nuzzel, Indigenous (my social reader), Signal. #digped

If you keep social media off your phone it can't get in your head. Keep work email off your phone and try to enjoy life.
